id: title:andehen:compute what a flag needs before evaluation in one place

review.posthog_relevance: Adds compatibility checks and regression tests for the HogQL v2 parser and flag requirements extraction, ensuring downstream group matching and property resolution do not break when v2-compatible configurations are used.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 adds compatibility checks, while P1.F7.H2 adds tests for the v2 parser and requirements extraction. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in correctness and reliability for the query planning and metadata components, but the chunk does not include the complete implementation of the v2 parser or downstream consumers, preventing a tier 3 assessment.
review.uncertainty: The chunk is incomplete; it lacks the full implementation and downstream consumers, so the systemic benefit and complete validation cannot be established. The score relies only on the compatibility checks and tests present, not the full v2 implementation.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the v2 parser, the complete definition of the v2 config, or the complete implementation of the v2-dependent downstream consumers. observations.behavior: Adds a new test, `requirements_read_every_v1_condition_with_matching_aggregation`, that checks the output of `FlagFilters::requirements()` against an expected `FlagRequirements` struct, including cohort IDs, flag IDs, and aggregation/group indexes.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the Rust implementation of flag requirements extraction correctly preserves cohort and flag IDs and aggregation indexes, which are used downstream for group matching and property resolution.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test, `requirements_read_the_parsed_v2_config`, that checks the output of `FlagFilters::requirements()` against an expected `FlagRequirements` struct, including cohort IDs, flag IDs, and aggregation/group indexes.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the Rust implementation of flag requirements extraction correctly preserves cohort and flag IDs and aggregation indexes, which are used downstream for group matching and property resolution.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test, `unsupported_documents_require_nothing`, that checks that unsupported document versions result in an empty `FlagRequirements` and a non-empty `non_v1` flag, while also checking that the requirements are empty.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that unsupported document versions do not cause incorrect requirements to be extracted, which could lead to incorrect group matching or property resolution.
